text: By far the most important way to recognize Switzerland, is that all car coverage is **low-cam**. This means that the camera on the Google car is intentionally set up lower than in most other countries. This can be recognized in two ways:
- The car blur is significantly bigger.
- Roads look wider and objects around you are seen from a lower angle.
Generally, the bigger car blur is the most consistent way to recognize low-cam.

NOTE: The only other countries that always have low-cam are [Japan](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192) and [Liechtenstein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jn7cXhtXQRG6Hd9a6).
text_zh: 識別瑞士迄今為止最重要的方法是，所有汽車街景覆蓋都是**低角度相機（low-cam）**。這意味著 Google 車上的相機故意設定得比大多數其他國家都要低。這可以透過兩種方式識別：
- 車影模糊範圍明顯更大。
- 道路看起來更寬，你周圍的物體是以更低的視角被看見。
通常來說，較大的車影模糊是辨識低相機視角最一致的方法。

注意：唯一其他總是使用低角度相機的國家是[日本](https://www.google.com/maps/@35.8415638,139.9145236,3a,75y,305.11h,83.84t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DLyYnyrI7fgLeL5Ev09XeJg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D33.088177%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)和[列支敦斯登](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jn7cXhtXQRG6Hd9a6)。

text: Swiss **licence plates** differ substantially from other European plates. They are fully white and lack the blue strip found in most other European countries.
**Front plates** are extremely short compared to most in Europe.
**Rear plates** can be either long or tall. In both cases the red country emblem can be seen on the left, while the canton emblem can be seen on the right.
text_zh: 瑞士**車牌**與其他歐洲車牌有很大不同。它們完全是白色的，且缺少大多數其他歐洲國家車牌上的藍色條紋。
與歐洲大多數車牌相比，**前車牌**極短。
**後車牌**可以是長的或高的。在這兩種情況下，紅色國家徽章都在左側，而州徽則在右側。

text: Swiss bollards are **black-and-white **with white or grey reflectors. They can be either wedge-shaped or cylindrical with a rounded top.
NOTE: Liechtenstein uses almost identical [round bollards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JJSg67HrDHerzv8c7).
text_zh: 瑞士路樁是**黑白相間的**，配有白色或灰色反光片。它們可以是楔形或帶有圓頂的圓柱形。
注意：列支敦斯登使用幾乎相同的[圓形路樁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JJSg67HrDHerzv8c7)。

text: The colour of **directional signs** indicates which type of road you are on. Main road signs will be blue, while side roads are white.

Major place names will frequently appear on blue signs, while smaller places tend to be on white signs. However, you can still find large city names on a [white sign](https://goo.gl/maps/pfJ2QNrPFmB7q6xN9).
text_zh: **方向標誌**的顏色表示你所在的道路類型。主幹道標誌為藍色，而小路標誌為白色。
主要地名經常會出現在藍色標誌上，而較小的地方則傾向於出現在白色標誌上。不過，你仍然可以在[白色標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/pfJ2QNrPFmB7q6xN9)上找到大城市名稱。

text: Swiss pedestrian signs have **seven stripes**, making it almost unique for Europe. Furthermore, rather than the typical European square shape, the signs appear as tall blue rectangles.
NOTE: Liechtenstein uses identical signs.
text_zh: 瑞士的行人穿越標誌有**七條條紋**，這在歐洲幾乎是獨一無二的。此外，這些標誌不是典型的歐洲正方形，而是顯示為高大的藍色長方形。
注意：列支敦斯登使用相同的標誌。

text: **Long dashed yellow** road lines are a good clue for Switzerland.
NOTE: These road lines are also common in Liechtenstein.
text_zh: **長而虛線的黃色**道路標線是識別瑞士的好線索。
注意：這些道路標線在列支敦斯登也很常見。

text: Pedestrian crossings are typically painted **yellow** and exclusive to Switzerland and [Liechtenstein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WLYNNkZAGCz7rDLg8) within Europe.
text_zh: 行人穿越道通常漆成**黃色**，在歐洲範圍內是瑞士和[列支敦斯登](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WLYNNkZAGCz7rDLg8)所獨有的。

text: Swiss road signs commonly have a round, grey **metal border** around them.

NOTE: [Liechtenstein](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wbSfjB8xPexuUkqZA) uses almost identical directional signs. Somewhat similar metal borders are found on some directional signs in [Denmark](https://goo.gl/maps/gQWu5BCRsga8WkiS7).
text_zh: 瑞士道路標誌周圍通常有一個圓形的灰色**金屬邊框**。
注意：[列支敦斯登](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wbSfjB8xPexuUkqZA)使用幾乎相同的方向標誌。[丹麥](https://goo.gl/maps/gQWu5BCRsga8WkiS7)的一些方向標誌上也能找到類似的金屬邊框。

text: Town entry signs in Switzerland are usually **white or blue**, with a **metal frame** around them.

NOTE: On the back of these signs you may often find the distance to larger, nearby cities. Furthermore, the abbreviation for the canton can often be seen on the bottom of the sign, especially when the town is situated near a canton border.
text_zh: 瑞士的城鎮入口標誌通常是**白色或藍色**，周圍帶有**金屬框**。
注意：在這些標誌的背面，你經常可以找到通往附近較大城市的距離。此外，標誌底部經常可以看到州的縮寫，特別是當城鎮位於州界附近時。

text: **Chevrons** are black with a white arrow. You may also rarely find chevrons that are [white with a black arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/S8YmmUW2vnbEQryN9).
NOTE: Austrian chevrons are red and white, or red and yellow.
text_zh: **轉彎標誌（chevron）**是黑色的，帶有白色箭頭。你也很少會找到[白色背景帶黑色箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/S8YmmUW2vnbEQryN9)的轉彎標誌。
註：奧地利的轉彎標誌為紅白相間，或是紅黃相間。

text: While the southern half of Switzerland is extremely mountainous, with long, thin valleys between the mountains, the northern half mostly consists of large farmlands on either flat ground or rolling hills, typically with forested hills in the distance.
text_zh: 瑞士南部半境極為多山，山與山之間有著狹長的山谷，而北部半境則大多由平地或緩丘的大片農田組成，遠處通常能見到長滿森林的山丘。

text: Swiss and Alpine architecture in general largely consists of **stone buildings** painted in light and warm colours, often combined with wooden parts and details. Roofs are typically tiled and of a gable type. It is extremely common for windows to have wooden shutters which open horizontally in two parts.
text_zh: 瑞士乃至阿爾卑斯山的建築風格，大體上由漆成淺色與暖色調的**石造建築**組成，通常會結合木造結構與細節。屋頂通常為瓦片鋪設的人字形屋頂。窗戶裝有能從中間向兩側水平開啟的木製百葉窗，這是極為常見的特色。

text: These bus stop signs, with thick **metal signposts** going around them, are unique to Switzerland.
text_zh: 這些公車候車亭站牌周圍繞著粗大的**金屬支柱**，是瑞士特有的景象。

text: Switzerland has **four official languages**: German, French, Italian and [Romansh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romansh_language), which are spoken in the regions shown. Note that some areas, mostly near the region borders, are bilingual.
NOTE: Unlike Germany and Austria, Swiss German does not use the letter **ß**.
text_zh: 瑞士有**四種官方語言**：德語、法語、義大利語及[羅曼什語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romansh_language)，其分佈區域如圖所示。請注意，有些地區（大多靠近語言區邊界）是雙語區。
註：與德國和奧地利不同，瑞士德語不使用 **ß** 這個字母。

text: The text on the **speed limit signs** varies depending on the official languages in the region.
text_zh: **速限標誌**上的文字會根據該地區的官方語言而有所不同。

text: **Cantons** are the first-level administrative division of Switzerland. It is very common to find the two-letter abbreviation for the canton that you are in, as seen on some town entry signs. As such, remembering these can be a great asset when region-guessing Switzerland.
NOTE: If you happen to come across an [unblurred licence plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA), the first two letters will correspond to the canton that it is registered in.
text_zh: **州（Cantons）**是瑞士的第一級行政區劃。你經常可以在某些城鎮入口標誌上找到你所在州的兩位字母縮寫。因此，記住這些縮寫在進行瑞士區域猜測（region-guessing）時會是一大優勢。
註：如果你剛好遇到一個[未模糊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA)，前兩個字母將對應到該車輛註冊的州。

text: The first digits of Swiss postal codes are a good way to regionguess the country. The general pattern is that the numbers increase from the west to east.
text_zh: 瑞士郵遞區號的第一位數字是推測該國區域的好方法。其大致規律是數字由西向東遞增。

text: **Elevation** is an important part of region-guessing Switzerland. The southern half of Switzerland is extremely mountainous, while the northern half mostly has smaller mountains and hills.
text_zh: **海拔高度**是推測瑞士區域的重要依據。瑞士南部半境極為多山，而北部半境則多為較小的山脈和丘陵。

text: A fairly flat landscape with a long chain of medium-sized, forested mountains northwest means you are likely south of the Jura Mountains.
text_zh: 如果地勢相當平坦，且西北方有一長串中等高度、長滿森林的山脈，意味著你很可能位於汝拉山脈以南。

text: **Exposed limestone rocks**, protruding from forested hills, are commonly found in the Jura mountains.
text_zh: **裸露的石灰岩**自森林山丘中突顯出來，這在汝拉山脈一帶很常見。

text: **Rock walls** are mainly found in the Jura mountains, but can also be found in the Alps, particularly in the Italian speaking parts.
text_zh: **石牆**主要分佈於汝拉山脈，但在阿爾卑斯山也能見到，特別是在義大利語區。

text: Not unexpectedly, seeing typical **Italian architecture** in Switzerland should imply that you are in the Italian-speaking areas in the south, principally the canton of Ticino.

The architectural style is characterized by, typically very smooth, orange-yellow stone walls with multiple floors and orange or brownish tiled roofs. Green and brown Italian-style window shutters are common.
text_zh: 不出所料，如果在瑞士看到典型的**義大利建築**，通常意味著你身處南部的義大利語區，主要是提契諾州。
這種建築風格的特點通常是非常平滑的橘黃色石牆，擁有好幾個樓層以及橘色或帶棕色的瓦片屋頂。綠色和棕色的義大利風格窗戶百葉窗十分常見。

text: Large houses with thick roofs, which are shaped like an **arch** **underneath**, are common around Bern.
text_zh: 伯恩周邊常見到屋頂厚重的大型房屋，其形狀呈**下方拱起**的弧形。

text: **Elaborate timber frames**, which are commonly painted red, are found in the northeast.
NOTE: [Simpler timber frames](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8cAS5uQ6KW7MVwux9) in other colours can be found in other parts of the country.
text_zh: 東北部則可見到通常漆成紅色的**精緻木骨架**。
註：該國其他地區也能見到其他顏色且[較簡單的木骨架](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8cAS5uQ6KW7MVwux9)。

text: Around Appenzell, most houses will consist of a large living house connected to a long barn, such that the roof of the living house and the barn are at a **90° angle**.
The front facade of the living house will often be divided into small squares, with each window being perfectly contained within a square.
text_zh: 在阿彭策爾一帶，大多數房屋由一棟大型住家連接一座長形穀倉組成，使得住家與穀倉的屋頂呈現 **90° 夾角**。
住家的正面外牆通常會被分割成許多小方塊，每個窗戶都完美地被包含在一個方塊之內。

text: In the canton of Graubünden, you will often come across houses entirely made of stone, with, most commonly white, **decorative painted details** around windows and the edges of the house.
text_zh: 在格勞賓登州，你經常會看到完全由石頭建造的房屋，窗戶周圍和房屋邊緣通常有白色的**裝飾彩繪細節**。

text: These **large** town entry signs can sometimes be found in the canton of Vaud.
text_zh: 沃州有時可以找到這些**大型**城鎮入口標誌。

text: **Olive green infrastructure**, particularly signposts, sign borders and sign backs, are found in Basel-Landschaft.
text_zh: **橄欖綠色的基礎設施**，特別是標誌柱、標誌邊框和標誌背面，常見於巴塞爾鄉村州。

text: In the canton of Valais, you will often see thick wooden bollards, which can either be **square-shaped** or **cylindrical**.
text_zh: 在瓦萊州，你經常會看到粗大的木製路樁，其形狀可能是**方形**或**圓柱形**。

text: In place of bollards, reflectors in the canton of Glarus will often be **attached to fences** following the road.
text_zh: 在格勞日斯州，道路旁的反射器通常不會使用路樁，而是**固定在圍籬上**。

text: In Geneva and in the valley between Martigny and Lake Geneva, you can find bike path symbols painted on the road with a **simplified person** on top of two **disconnected wheels**.
NOTE: This stands in contrast to the rest of the country, where the symbol will be a [somewhat detailed bike](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1zfGBch8koTPW4pLA).
text_zh: 在日內瓦以及馬蒂尼與日內瓦湖之間的山谷中，你可以在道路上找到自行車道符號，其圖案上方是一個**簡化的人形**，踩著兩個**分離的車輪**。
註：這與該國其他地區形成對比，其他地區的符號是[稍微詳細的自行車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1zfGBch8koTPW4pLA)。

text: You may find several different types of **road dividers** across the country, distributed as seen in this graphic.
_This image was provided by quarksauce. You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 你可能會在全國各地看到幾種不同類型的**道路護欄**，其分佈如本圖所示。
_這張圖片由 quarksauce 提供。你可以點擊圖片將其放大。_

text: If the area around your location appears hilly, but not mountainous, and you manage to catch a glimpse of a large lake to the south, with **tall mountains** on the other side, then you are very likely north of Lake Geneva.
text_zh: 如果你所在的位置周圍看似丘陵而非高山，且你瞥見南邊有一座大湖，湖對岸有**高聳的山脈**，那麼你極有可能位於日內瓦湖以北。

text: Seeing a wide lake to the northeast, situated in a landscape with relatively low elevation, means you should be looking at **Lake Constance **(on some Maps labelled as the Bodensee).
NOTE: Due to the low-lying landscape, you will probably be fairly close to the shore if you see the lake.
text_zh: 如果在海拔相對較低的景觀中看到東北方有一座寬闊的湖泊，這意味著你看到的應該是**博登湖**（Lake Constance，在地圖上有時標示為 Bodensee）。
註：由於地勢低窪，如果你看到該湖泊，你可能距離湖岸相當近。

text: The valley of Martigny has the highest density of **fruit plantations** in the country. It can easily be recognized by the many small fruit trees in combination with the wide, flat valley with large mountains on either side.
text_zh: 馬蒂尼山谷擁有全國最高的**果園**密度。透過許多小型果樹結合寬闊平坦的山谷以及兩側的高山，可以輕易辨認出這裡。

text: Apart from the valley of Martigny, the most likely area to find **fruit trees** is near Lake Constance, followed by the area northwest of Lake Geneva.
text_zh: 除了馬蒂尼山谷外，最有可能找到**果樹**的地區是在博登湖附近，其次是日內瓦湖西北方的地區。

text: In the canton of Graubünden, you can find this unique and easily recognizable **train coverage** on the tracks of the “Bernina Express.” It runs around most of the canton, all the way down to Tirano in Italy.
text_zh: 在格勞賓登州，你可以在「伯尼納快車」（Bernina Express）的鐵軌上找到這種獨特且易於辨識的**火車街景覆蓋**。它行駛於該州大部分地區，一路延伸至義大利的蒂拉諾。

text: **Generation 2** coverage is very limited in Switzerland. It can be found mostly near the border between the cantons of Bern and Valais, and on a few very short stretches in Schaffhausen.
NOTE: This does not include the many ski resorts with Generation 2 snow coverage, which can be found throughout the southern half of the country.
text_zh: 瑞士的**第二代（Generation 2）**街景覆蓋非常有限。它主要分佈在伯恩州和瓦萊州的交界附近，以及沙夫豪森的幾個極短路段上。
註：這不包含位於南部半境各地、擁有第二代雪地街景覆蓋的眾多滑雪勝地。

text: These blue street signs, with **rounded edges** on the sides, are unique to the city of Sankt Gallen.
text_zh: 這些兩側有**圓潤邊緣**的藍色街道標誌，是聖加侖市特有的景象。

text: Large blue street signs, attached to a **low double signpost**, similar to directional signs in [Denmark](https://maps.app.goo.gl/234Fd9GSuZQRtH47A), are found in Basel.
text_zh: 大型藍色街道標誌固定在**低矮的雙標誌柱**上，類似[丹麥](https://maps.app.goo.gl/234Fd9GSuZQRtH47A)的指路標誌，可在巴塞爾找到。

text: Downtown Bern can be recognized by this **specific architecture**. Grey toned buildings, typically with four floors and large, somewhat rounded openings lined up on the ground floor are common.
text_zh: 伯恩市中心可以透過這種**特定的建築風格**來辨識。灰色調的建築通常有四層樓，底樓則排列著大型且帶點圓弧形的開口，這點十分常見。
